annotations.title: Find privacy alternatives to a product

description: Use when a user wants to replace a mainstream product: consumer apps and services (Gmail, WhatsApp, Chrome, Google Drive, Zoom, LastPass, Windows…) or a website tracker / ad script (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Mixpanel, Facebook Pixel…). Pass the product's name. Trackers return a curated swap list. Consumer products return a hand-picked list of directory tools that replace them (DP picks first, then the rest of the list), plus what_changes (what switching involves, e.g. your contacts must install the new messenger too) and related guides and stacks, each with its url. Each tool carries dp_url.

product.description: The product to replace, by name, e.g. 'WhatsApp', 'Gmail', 'Google Analytics'.
